description.narrow: Semporna — материковый морской gateway к Sipadan и Tun Sakaran Marine Park; основной экспедиционный контекст — лодки, permits/park rules, море и рифовые системы.

migration.note: Legacy route regions/hubs are kept as geographic_area until formal administrative or settlement identity is verified.

geography: Прибрежный город восточного Sabah у Darvel Bay/Celebes Sea; окружающие острова имеют вулканическое и коралловое происхождение.

geology.summary: Tun Sakaran islands include Quaternary pyroclastic volcanic landforms; Sipadan is an oceanic coral island built on a volcanic cone.

transport.note: Sabah Parks identifies Semporna as gateway for both Sipadan and Tun Sakaran; in calm seas Sipadan is about 45 minutes by speedboat.

marine.biodiversity: Tun Sakaran published records include 255 coral species, 528 reef-fish species, more than 240 marine invertebrates and six seagrass species; Sipadan has more than 400 fish species and hundreds of coral species.
marine.weather: Eastern Sabah marine forecast is mandatory context for boat transfers.

safety.caveat: Police district is not necessarily the same as the administrative district; unreported crimes are absent. These are absolute counts, not a population-normalized rate and not a safety score.
